flags.message: The snapshot records a September 18, 2026 merits brief from the court-appointed amicus defending the judgment, but the provisioned document manifest contains no such text. The August 5 respondent merits brief instead supports vacatur. Both supplied merits briefs were considered, but the opposing merits presentation is unavailable in the baseline; confidence was reduced accordingly. Consider provisioning court-appointed merits briefs where the respondent does not defend the judgment.
